title: T.O Magic 'n Extras Reimagined
description: This resource pack has changed the texture and model of the weapon in T.O Magic 'n Extras Reimagined
body:
About This Pack:

This resource pack was initially created for my own modpack, but you are expressly permitted to use it in any of your modpacks.

Current State & Future Plans:

Now, it has two models, More updates are coming, I created a glow texture for my new model, but for some reason it isn't working. If anyone can help solve the problem, please message me privately or leave a comment below. Thanks!

Feedback & Contributions:

Your suggestions and ideas for future weapon models and textures are highly welcome in the comment section. If you are interested in contributing directly, please reach out to me via the comments.
